title: Defects per circuit board
intro: X is the number of defects on a circuit board from one assembly line, from 0 to 5, with the probabilities in the table. They are all positive and add to 1, so this is a valid PMF. The value of interest is k = 1 with an upper value k₂ = 3: read P(1 ≤ X ≤ 3) = 0.53, the chance of one to three defects. P(X ≥ 1) = 0.60 is the chance that a board needs any rework.
